Goblins. We all know 'em, we all...well, love is a strong word, but they're definitely hard to miss. An all-female race, the most common features of a goblin are as follows:
1. Height: A mature goblin is between three and four feet tall.
2. Skin: Goblins have green skin, although that can vary from a pale olive to a deep emerald.
3. Eyes: Goblins have red eyes.
4. Teeth: Goblins have sharp little chompers, giving them an almost piranha-like look.
5. Ears: Goblins have long, expressive pointed ears.

Of course, the features most people pay attention to are their bodies. Goblins are, to a woman, thick-as-hell shortstacks. We're talking breasts that start at 'big' and top out at 'gargantuan,' asses that make them taller when they sit down, and hips that go beyond 'curvy' and practically redefine 'child-bearing.' Goblin family names harken back to Goblins' woodland origins among the moss and insects, with names like 'Tubegrub,' 'Mossworm,' 'Many-Ants,' 'Loambeetle,' 'Goldenfly' and so on.

Not just Goblin sisters, but when you start factoring in cousins--lot of branches on these family trees. Given this, it's pretty common for Goblins to form closer bonds with just a handful of their sisters--Goblins call this 'picking your Closest.' A Goblin might say, "Oh, have you met Ikko? She's one of my Closest." 

Outside of their Closest, Goblins still feel familial affection towards all their sisters and cousins (aside from the inevitable family drama--they're just like us, in that way), just in a more...diffused way. Can't really get to know your whole family when your sisters alone number more than you can count on two hands!

Goblins that have the experience and/or the inclination for it become Den Mothers, raising and caring for any number of their daughters or nieces, usually in one of the Hive Cities. This frees up Goblin mothers to get back out there and pursue their dreams (or, you know, have even more kids). The typical ratio of Den Mother to Goblin girls under her care is 1:10.

It goes without saying that Goblin family reunions are a BIG affair, and even 'quick' family video calls require a few hours and sophisticated conferencing technology. But they make it work. Goblins care about family. If they didn't, they wouldn't make so damn many of them!

Hive Cities are vast, underground settlements that hold the majority of Goblinkind on Earth. How many there are, and their exact locations, is a secret known only to the highest orders of the Goblin government.
